name: memar
description: Operating practices for Memar and Khayyam in any project. Discovers live docs from the GeniusesGroup/memar root (workspace or shallow clone); Markdown/Git paths resolve against that root, not the skill install path.

interface.longDescription: Use Memar's approach in any project — not only inside this repository. The bundled skill establishes a Memar root (current workspace when it is GeniusesGroup/memar, otherwise a shallow clone named memar) and resolves ordinary Markdown/Git paths in the skill and across docs against that root.
defaultPrompt: Apply Memar's approach — read Cognition and the relevant live docs first.
Design this the Memar / Khayyam way using the canonical documentation.
